conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, holding a larger cash buffer for safety and lower drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad market exposure with some tactical hedging and quality tech.
